samples.claim: union_predicate inserts exactly base fields satisfying the predicate; subtract_predicate removes exactly matching IDs. Neither repairs parent/child closure or touches metadata flags, so later Field::apply_projection can assert if a selected nested parent loses all children. intersect takes set intersection and ANDs all metadata flags, retaining Self base and blob mode without compatibility checks between bases/modes. Its allocations collect a new HashSet.
samples.review_note: Predicate insert/remove and intersection flags match. Supplemental field.rs274-309 confirms assertion for a selected nested parent with no projected children.

samples.claim: BlobLayout externalizes large binary payloads and stores position/size descriptions. (position=0,size=0) means empty; (nonzero position,size=0) means null and position carries repdef. inner_layout PageLayout=1 encodes descriptions with exactly one all-valid-item repdef layer, while outer layers repeated=2 describe original structure. Conflating zero-length null and empty corrupts semantics.
samples.evidence:
324 | /* A layout where large binary data is encoded externally and only
325 |  * the descriptions (position + size) are placed in the page
326 |  *
327 |  * Repdef information is stored in the descriptions.  A description with a size of
328 |  * 0 and a position of 0 is an empty value.  A description with a size of 0 and a
329 |  * non-zero position is a null value and the position is the repdef value.
330 |  */
331 | message BlobLayout {
332 |   // The inner layout used to store the descriptions
333 |   PageLayout inner_layout = 1;
334 |   /* The meaning of each repdef layer, used to interpret repdef buffers correctly
335 |    *
336 |    * The inner layout's repdef layers will always be 1 all valid item layer
337 |    */
338 |   repeated RepDefLayer layers = 2;
339 | }
340 |
samples.review_note: Both empty/null description cases and inner/outer layer declarations match schema exactly.

samples.claim: compute_stats scans all values, updates min/max and count, then marks sorted=false if a later value is below running maximum. Equal adjacent values remain sorted; this detects nondecreasing order, not strict uniqueness. Empty stats are min0/max0/count0/sortedtrue. Ordinary u64 count increment has no overflow error.
samples.review_note: Running extrema/count and strict-less sorted check match; equal values do not unset sorted.

samples.claim: PQ records num_bits=1, num_sub_vectors=2, dimension=3, repeated float codebook=4, and Tensor codebook_tensor=5. Both codebook descriptions require dimension times 2^num_bits scalar values. This is metadata, not the sub-vector layout or distance implementation; no legal-bit-range validation appears.
samples.review_note: All five PQ fields/tags and both codebook size comments match; runtime validation not inferred.

samples.claim: Struct null-child fixture accepts first row[1,2] and rejects second[null,3]. All tests read, not executed. This file has no direct builder/config/intersection/protobuf roundtrip fixture; core Bloom tests cover lower-level algorithms, not full concurrent transaction correctness.
samples.review_note: Both struct components and accepted/rejected rows match assertions. Full test file was previously read; no execution claimed.

samples.claim: cfg(test) imports and bitmap helper plus flat schema fixture: five nullable Int32 fields named field_0..4, Arrow-to-Lance conversion then set_field_id(None). Test helpers use unwrap; no production schema mutation occurs.
samples.review_note: Matches five nullable Int32 fixture fields, conversion and assigned IDs.

samples.claim: cursor_with_dense_range_expansion chooses dense mode only for exactly one RangeWithBitmap segment. It computes segment.len once, seeds cached length and calls segment density advisory; other shapes return an uncached default cursor/false. The threshold is segment.len>=bitmap.len-floor(bitmap.len/4), from segment.rs346-354. This avoids repeating initial popcount but does not validate storage or select among multiple dense segments.
samples.review_note: Exactly one bitmap arm and cached cardinality match. Supplemental segment.rs346-354 confirms density formula.

samples.claim: compute_new_addr binary-searches destination start ranks, selecting the exact start or predecessor insertion index, then packs fragment ID and (rank-start) cast to u32 through RowAddress. No end check is performed here; construction cardinality plus a valid retained rank guarantees a destination exists and the offset fits that destination. Direct misuse of this private helper with an invalid rank could panic or truncate. GroupRemap DeepSizeOf measures the destination tuple vector.
samples.review_note: Binary search/predecessor, unchecked cast and deep-size delegation match. Supplemental391-470 and563-625 confirms constructor cardinality and valid-rank call path.

samples.claim: The cfg(test) module imports Arrow fixtures and the local trait/context. test_basic_record_batch makes one Int32 column [1,2,3] and asserts deep size >=12 bytes. It verifies a lower bound, not exact RecordBatch metadata accounting.
samples.review_note: Matches one three-value Int32 column and >=12 lower-bound assertion.

samples.claim: read_dataset_versions uses prost decode, mapping malformed protobuf to Internal with Failed to decode RowDatasetVersionSequence text. Every run must have span or Internal Missing positions in RowDatasetVersionRun; U64Segment::try_from errors propagate. Collects decoded runs, preserving order/versions. No cross-run positional normalization, equal-neighbor merge, empty-run filter, unique-row or length-alignment check is performed here.
samples.review_note: Decode/missing-span Internal errors, segment conversion and collection match; no cross-run normalization added.

samples.claim: ExternalFile is a table-relative path=1 plus byte offset=2 and size=3, documented for fragment reuse index details rather than the removed external lineage arms. FragmentTreeMetadata.layout currently has one tree=1 alternative; it selects the fragment storage layout. Removed external lineage arms: protos/fragment_metadata.proto:74-81.

samples.claim: Explicit UpdateMemWalState-left cross-kind arms against Append, Delete, Overwrite, CreateIndex, Rewrite, Merge, Restore, ReserveFragments, Update, Project, UpdateConfig, DataReplacement, Clone each compare std::mem::discriminant(self) with other. These are distinct variants, so every listed arm returns false independently of payload. No metadata-overlap or commit compatibility decision is made. Later UpdateBases and DataOverlay arms complete those pairs; blank separators carry no runtime behavior.

samples.claim: test_resolve_with_quoted_fields constructs Schema directly, bypassing validation and retaining unassigned IDs, to resolve a top-level dotted name in backticks, normal root, dotted nested child and normal nested child. It checks returned ancestry length/names and equivalent field lookup. A double-quoted nonexistent path returns None, but this does not demonstrate double-quote syntax support. The manual schema's dotted root would fail normal Schema::try_from validation.
samples.review_note: Manual schema construction and quoted resolutions match. Supplemental schema331-346/889-907 confirms dotted-root rejection under normal conversion.

samples.claim: push accepts one Option<u16> per old physical row. For Some, reject out-of-range label and checked per-destination u32 increment overflow before advancing any physical counters; None only advances physical counters. total_rows increments as ordinary u64. When rows_in_block reaches block_rows, append a full snapshot of all running counters and reset rows_in_block to zero. A destination can hold at most u32::MAX rows, whose last zero-based offset is u32::MAX-1; this builder cannot represent count2^32.
samples.review_note: Checked destination increment precedes physical counters, block snapshot and reset match. u32-count limitation is arithmetic deduction.

samples.claim: RangeWithHoles validates range, requires holes message, decodes array, rejects non-strict order with adjacent indices/values, then rejects any hole outside half-open range. It preserves encoded array representation/base; no canonical rebasing or requirement for nonempty holes. Errors are CorruptFile with detailed range/hole context.
samples.review_note: Ordered range/required-array/strict-order/bounds checks and preserved representation match.

samples.claim: get_with_key builds canonical key and awaits backend get with codec. None increments misses once; successful downcast increments hits once and returns Arc<T>. Cancellation before a backend result records neither counter.
samples.review_note: Backend await precedes counters; exactly one hit or miss, wrong-type warning and no retry/eviction/accessor registration match.
